result.title: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes
result.summary: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PlanarCityLoc，用轻量无纹理 LoD 城市模型的建筑立面与屋顶平面几何替代轮廓重叠，通过图像平面块与模型平面的 3D-2D 对应和 PnP 精化无人机位姿。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于单帧航拍位姿估计的任务专用几何方法，不涉及 latent 状态生成、证据使用或停止决策，也未触及 VLM 推理；虽提及「消除轮廓歧义」，但该歧义指向相机位姿而非推理状态，缺少可核查的借鉴线索。
